# Jotform

> > Jotform is a comprehensive no-code platform for building forms, apps, workflows, and automating business processes with drag-and-drop simplicity.

Jotform provides a unified suite of tools for form creation, data collection, and workflow automation with 20,000+ templates and integrations with major platforms like PayPal, Salesforce, and Microsoft Teams. The platform serves businesses of all sizes with no-code solutions for payments, e-signatures, scheduling, and team collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Form Builder
- No-Code Platform
- Drag-and-Drop
- Template Library
- Workflow Automation
- Payment Processing
- E-Signature
- Integrations
- Form Submissions
- Team Collaboration
- Business Automation
- Data Collection
- AI Agents
- Jotform Tables
- Document Automation

## Core Platform

- [Free Online Form Builder & Form Creator for 2026 | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com): Jotform homepage: drag-and-drop form builder for registrations, payments, and workflows

## Template Libraries

- [20,000+ Free Online Form Templates & Form Examples | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/form-templates): 20,000+ customizable form templates for applications, orders, feedback, and more
- [800+ Free No-Code App Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/app-templates): 800+ no-code app templates with scheduling, booking, and AI chatbot automation
- [300+ Free Table Templates | Jotform Tables](https://www.jotform.com/table-templates): 300+ Jotform Tables templates for CRM, budgeting, and data organization
- [200+ Free Workflow Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/workflow-templates): 200+ automation templates for order processing, recruiting, and expense management
- [2,000+ Jotform PDF Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/pdf-templates): 2,000+ PDF templates for business documents and e-signature workflows
- [900+ Jotform Sign Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/pdf-templates/e-sign): 900+ e-signature and contract templates for document automation
- [7,000+ Free AI Agent Examples | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/agent-templates): 7,000+ AI agent templates for customer support, sales, and lead generation
- [1,000+ Free Board Examples | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/board-templates): 1,000+ board templates for project management and team collaboration
